excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, the AI Agent track has been evolving from tools toward "human-like" entities. Large models have learned to converse, Agents have learned to execute, and Proactive Agents can even take initiative—but for AI to truly resemble humans, more is needed. SentiPulse’s choice: give the Agent a face. On April 23, SentiPulse’s public beta product, SentiCat, brought this concept to life—a virtual character named SUSU, with a Live2D appearance, is responsible for companionship, understanding users, and building relationships, while its "AI Cat" handles productivity tasks such as data analysis and industry research. In SentiPulse’s design philosophy, the digital human is the shell, and the Agent is the skeleton—a face with warmth and expression gives the system’s underlying powerful capabilities a reason to be opened and trusted by users over the long term. With both a face and a skeleton. When first opening SentiCat, SUSU guides the user through initialization: obtaining authorization via a few questions, scanning the computer environment, and generating a personalized "user profile." Thereafter, users make requests in natural language, and SUSU dispatches the Cat to execute tasks while conversing—invoking plugins, accessing local files, and combining web search with data analysis to deliver results. The capability boundaries of this architecture are not locked by factory settings. SentiCat has a built-in plugin marketplace that supports one-click installation and is compatible with external Skills and MCP servers.
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, el sector de los Agentes de IA ha evolucionado de herramientas a "personas". Los grandes modelos aprenden a dialogar, los Agentes aprenden a ejecutar, y los Agentes Proactivos incluso pueden actuar por iniciativa propia, pero para que la IA sea realmente como un humano, se necesita más. La elección de SentiPulse es: darle un rostro al Agente. El 23 de abril, el producto de prueba pública de SentiPulse, SentiCat, materializó esta idea: el personaje virtual SUSU, con una imagen Live2D, se encarga de acompañar, conocer al usuario y establecer relaciones, mientras que su "gatito de IA" asume tareas como análisis de datos e investigación de la industria.
